privacyPolicy:
Privacy Policy for StudyMate

Last updated: October 17, 2026

StudyMate ('we', 'our', or 'us') is committed to protecting your privacy and student data. This Privacy Policy explains how information about you is collected, used, and safeguarded when you use our mobile application.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
- Account Information: When you create an account, we collect your name and email address through Firebase Authentication.
- Study Content: We store your notes, tasks, weekly timetable, study timer sessions, exam dates, and quiz scores locally on your device and synchronized to your private Cloud Firestore account.
- Sensitive Data: We do NOT collect payment card details or precise GPS location.

2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
- To provide, synchronize, and improve your personal study tools.
- To send local study notifications and deadline reminders.
- To authenticate your access across your registered devices.

3. LOCAL AND CLOUD STORAGE
Your records are stored primarily in an encrypted or sandboxed local SQLite database on your device. When signed in, records sync securely to Firebase Firestore protected by UID-based Security Rules.

4. DATA DELETION & EXPORT
You retain complete ownership of your data. You can export all your records as structured JSON at any time from Settings > Data Export. You may also permanently delete your account and all associated cloud data via Settings > Delete Account.

5. CONTACT US
If you have any questions or data concerns, contact us at support@studymate.app.
